info.name: CYCLES_DEVICE_SELECTION
info.comment: Cycles vendor extension: explicit compute-device (render backend) selection on the ANARI_DEVICE. Parameters are read when the Cycles session is created on first use of the device; changing them afterwards has no effect. The ANARI_CYCLES_FORCE_CPU environment variable overrides both parameters (for containers/CI). The device also reports the read-only properties 'computeDevices' (ANARI_STRING_LIST of available backends) and 'computeDevice'/'computeDevice.size' (ANARI_STRING, the backend actually in use).

parameters.name: computeDevice
parameters.description: compute backend used for rendering; 'auto' picks OptiX, then CUDA, then CPU; an unavailable or unrecognized selection warns and falls back to 'auto'

parameters.name: computeDeviceIndex
parameters.description: index into the enumerated devices of the selected backend (for multi-GPU hosts); an out-of-range index warns and uses device 0
